Forest stage PBR textures — Poly Haven CC0 1.0
----------------------------------------------
Downloaded at 1k JPG (Diffuse, nor_gl, Rough, AO) by
tools/fetch-forest-pbr-textures.py.

  dirt_floor     → Forest packed-dirt ribbon
  gravel_road    → Forest gravel stretches + shoulder grain
  forest_floor   → Forest land / skirt plane
  tunnel_rock    → Forest tunnel tube / mouth collar
                   (Poly Haven boulder_01 1k: diff + nor_gl + arm)

License: assets/props/POLYHAVEN-LICENSE.txt
https://polyhaven.com/license
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Do not substitute 8k maps at runtime. Hero-zone quality here is photographic
tiling at ~2 m, not canvas grain and not stretched 15 m repeats.
